findings.current: {count, plural, other {{count, number, ::group-off} dấu chưa đọc không có mã xác nhận hoàn tất nên không thể xóa.}}
findings.problem: "completion token" is rendered «mã xác nhận hoàn tất». The binding vi style guide (~/local-operator/i18n/style-guides/vi.md, 'Kept-English technical list') keeps «token» in English, and every sibling vi key keeps it: 57 occurrences, e.g. ui.settings.account.settings_page.tokens «Token», ui.settings.account.settings_usage_chart.tokens_used «Token đã dùng», ui.mesh.mesh_actions.mint_the_token «Tạo token». «mã xác nhận» is the Vietnamese phrase for a verification/authorisation code — the exact security-token reading the English context note forbids ('never as a security token') — and no other vi key uses «mã xác nhận», so a reader meets an invented term with no precedent in the product.
findings.suggested: {count, plural, other {{count, number, ::group-off} dấu chưa đọc không có token hoàn tất nên không thể xóa.}} — keep the Latin «token» and let «hoàn tất» carry the completion sense; «token báo hoàn tất» is an acceptable fuller variant. Do not use «mã xác nhận».
findings.evidence: grep of src/i18n/catalogues/vi/*.json at 28a6127: «token» in 57 keys, «mã xác nhận» only in this key; style guide sha256 e4901497ed553e2b2ae4a2660bf776adb787b89e11d7eb0f8d08f3da4b227888; context note for this key quoted from en/ui.chat.sidebar.context.json (sha256 4f1593cc34b395ef8701a60e58e73a0371b3c93730eb7a1f2b2845dc6250d7e3)

per_key_checks.current_text: {count, plural, other {Đánh dấu {count, number, ::group-off} cuộc trò chuyện chưa đọc là đã đọc.}}
per_key_checks.assessment: Meaning exact ('Mark N unread conversations as read'); no omission/addition, polarity correct, plain declarative with a single full stop. Argument name {count} and the {count, number, ::group-off} skeleton byte-identical to source. 'other'-only plural is correct for vi (binding style guide: «'other' only — Vietnamese has no plural agreement; never add one/other branches»). «cuộc trò chuyện» matches nav.chats/row.unread_suffix; «là đã đọc» matches ui.notifications.toast.marked_read.
per_key_checks.plural_select: vi: other only; rendered for 0/1/2/5/12/1000000 by hand-check of the single branch

per_key_checks.current_text: {count, plural, other {Đánh dấu {count, number, ::group-off} cuộc trò chuyện chưa đọc là đã đọc}}, trong đó có {elsewhere, plural, other {{elsewhere, number, ::group-off} cuộc trò chuyện không đang hoạt động}}.
per_key_checks.assessment: Both arguments and both numbers keep their ::group-off skeleton; the outer plural wraps only the first clause and the comma follows it exactly as in English, so the whole sentence carries one full stop. «trong đó có» keeps the SUBSET sense (elsewhere is part of count, never an addition). «không đang hoạt động» renders the backend's 'not active' class plainly and with no section name, and agrees with sibling usage of 'active' (ui.notifications.flag.seen_hint «khi bạn đang hoạt động ở đây»). The one nit is the repeated noun.
per_key_checks.plural_select: vi: other only on both plurals

per_key_checks.source: {count, plural, one {{count, number, ::group-off} unread mark with no completion token cannot be cleared.} other {{count, number, ::group-off} unread marks with no completion token cannot be cleared.}}
per_key_checks.current_text: {count, plural, other {{count, number, ::group-off} dấu chưa đọc không có mã xác nhận hoàn tất nên không thể xóa.}}
per_key_checks.assessment: Structure and polarity fine: 'cannot be cleared' preserved (not negated twice, not softened), the added «nên» makes the English implied causation explicit and is natural; «xóa» for 'cleared' is consistent with the receipt copy (ui.notices.chat.mark_all_read_none_cleared «Không có gì được xóa.», mark_all_read_unknown «Không xóa được {count} …»), so deletion-of-a-chat misreading is a leftover the whole product already shares, not this key's defect. «dấu chưa đọc» is acceptable for a drawn mark (unreadMarkKind). The defect is the term for 'completion token'.

Byte-identical to source and CORRECT for this script: Vietnamese is space-separated Latin script, so two whole sentences joined by one U+0020 is the language's own separator (no full-width punctuation, no CJK-style empty separator). Both placeholders kept, in the natural order, nothing added. Combined output reads «Đánh dấu 5 … là đã đọc. 5 dấu chưa đọc … nên không thể xóa.» — two sentences, two full stops, no run-on.

per_key_checks.source: , including {elsewhere, plural, one {{elsewhere, number, ::group-off} that is not active} other {{elsewhere, number, ::group-off} that are not active}}
per_key_checks.current_text: , trong đó có {elsewhere, plural, other {{elsewhere, number, ::group-off} cuộc trò chuyện không đang hoạt động}}
per_key_checks.assessment: Starts with an ASCII comma + space so it joins the label with no constructor-added separator (chat-sidebar.tsx appends it in an sr-only span after the label span), and carries no trailing punctuation, matching the context note. Label stays a prefix of the accessible name (WCAG 2.5.3): «Đánh dấu tất cả 5 đã đọc» + «, trong đó có 2 cuộc trò chuyện không đang hoạt động» reads naturally as one clause in Vietnamese. {elsewhere, number, ::group-off} intact.

per_key_checks.current_text: Đánh dấu tất cả {count, number, ::group-off} đã đọc
per_key_checks.assessment: Pre-existing key (unchanged in this PR except for the trailing comma); read only as the prefix the new suffix is appended to. Matches ui.notifications.action.mark_all_read «Đánh dấu tất cả đã đọc» with the count inserted, so the visible label and the new tooltip verb agree. No finding raised against it, and its shed-width behaviour is not re-litigated here.

observations: «không đang hoạt động» resolves the translator's flagged uncertainty: 'active' is already rendered «hoạt động» in sibling copy (ui.notifications.flag.seen_hint «khi bạn đang hoạt động ở đây»), so the plain class sense is kept and no section name was invented.
«là đã đọc» for 'as read' matches ui.notifications.toast.marked_read «Đã đánh dấu {count} mục là đã đọc»; «Đánh dấu … đã đọc» matches ui.notifications.row.mark_read / mark_all_read.
«xóa» for 'cleared' matches the shipped receipt sentence for this same feature (ui.notices.chat.mark_all_read_none_cleared «Không có gì được xóa.»).
Typography: ASCII comma + one space, no space before punctuation, full stops only where the English has them, no '!', sentence case, no Title Case — matches the vi guide.
All six strings are NFC (verified by codepoint comparison); no Cf/Cc or bidi control characters present.
Key parity: 86 English vs 86 vi keys, none added or dropped; the file is valid JSON and the five new keys are the only additions in this PR (en diff 9d257a7^..28a6127 adds exactly these five).
